why: THE ONE PLACE THE CRASH SINK'S ADDRESS IS WRITTEN. Every workflow that talks to
GlitchTip reads org and project OUT OF THIS FILE at run time. Nothing spells either
into a workflow's `run:`, and nothing derives them from `matrix.app`.
🔴 WHY NOT DERIVED FROM THE APP SLUG, when almost everything else here is.
A GlitchTip project slug is a name on a REMOTE SERVER. Renaming apps/<slug> is a
commit; renaming that project is `PUT /api/0/projects/nikatru/<slug>/` against the
live instance. They are two facts, and deriving one from the other asserts they move
together. On 2026-09-09 they did not: the app slug moved to `subscriptiontracker`,
the GlitchTip project was still `subly`, and every symbol upload in the pipeline
POSTed to /projects/nikatru/subscriptiontracker/files/difs/assemble/ and took a 404.
In the Apple lane that 404 sat BETWEEN the .ipa and the step that reads its
signature back, so GitHub skipped the packaging and the proof — a monitoring outage
decided whether a shippable artifact was known to be signed.
🔴 WHY NOT A LITERAL IN THE WORKFLOW EITHER. That was the first repair, and
tooling/ci/assert-release-lane-generic.mjs refused it, correctly: [pipeline 10]D-2b
abolishes per-app workflow authoring, and an app id typed into a deploy lane's `run`
is exactly that — shipping app #2 would mean finding and editing every copy on the
one lane that reaches users. An app id belongs to the matrix leg or to a FILE THE
LANE READS AT RUN TIME. This is that file, and it is not the matrix leg because the
value is not per-app: it is one crash sink for the portfolio.
CHANGING THE PROJECT MEANS TWO THINGS, IN THIS ORDER: rename it on the live instance
(the project row is kept, so the issue history and the DSN survive — measured
2026-09-09: 14 issues, ids and event counts unchanged, same key), THEN change the
value here. `node tooling/ci/assert-glitchtip-project.mjs --live` reads the server
back and refuses if the two disagree.
⚠️ THE ISSUE SHORT-ID PREFIX IS RENDERED FROM THIS SLUG, NOT STORED. Renaming the
project re-renders every issue's short id, suffix unchanged: SUBLY-9 became
SUBSCRIPTIONTRACKER-9, both issue id 21, 4 events. Corpus references to the old
prefix resolve by substituting the new one; nothing was orphaned.
